name: A player can skin an emptied corpse another ungrouped player killed (#6356)
contract: Requires CoALegendaryItems.DropChance=0: this scenario checks skinning an otherwise empty corpse.
Skinning 8613 carries SPELL_ATTR2_CANNOT_CAST_ON_TAPPED in the client's Spell.dbc, which made Spell::CheckCast
refuse with SPELL_FAILED_CANT_CAST_ON_TAPPED (18) every character who was not the loot recipient or in its
group. A corpse only becomes skinnable once its loot is gone, so another player's kill is skinnable by anyone
with the skill. Black Riding Wolf 5194 is a beast with skinning table 100001 and no creature loot or money, so
its corpse becomes skinnable as soon as it dies. The skinner never fights it and is not grouped with the killer.

steps.label: The skinner skins a corpse another player killed
The skinning is not refused as tapped
The skinning loot window opens for the skinner
